The '''YT Dart''' was a model of small [[spacetug]] designed by an authorized affiliate of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] to serve as an auxiliary craft for [[YT-1300 light freighter]]s. A compact [[Starship|ship]] with a narrow [[viewport]], the YT Dart fit between the front mandibles of the YT-1300, seemingly extending its prow and giving it a sleeker appearance. When [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] owned the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', he had a YT Dart modified into a maneuverable two-passenger [[Escape pod|life pod]] by sealing its viewport and installing both a [[hyperdrive]] and a more powerful [[sublight engine]].<ref name="OWM" />
